recipes.label: GLM-5.3-Flash · UD-Q4_K_XL
recipes.verification: llama.cpp (GGUF) · verified on 1× B300 (67 tok/s)

verified.note: 1× B300 · upstream llama.cpp 3bb63cbcbfb62056c84fe9e521b0f3d756d29c32 · 67 tok/s single-stream, ~23 tok/s per stream with two busy · 193 GB VRAM · 524,288 ctx across 4 slots (131,072 per slot)
low and high are explicit; all other inputs use max

recipes.install: export PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH CUDACXX=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc && apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y pciutils build-essential cmake curl libcurl4-openssl-dev git python3-venv && python3 -m venv /workspace/mercury-host/hf && /workspace/mercury-host/hf/bin/pip install -U huggingface_hub && if ! test -d /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp; then git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp; fi && git -C /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp checkout 3bb63cbcbfb62056c84fe9e521b0f3d756d29c32 && cmake /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp -B /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp/build -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap --format=csv,noheader | head -n 1 | tr -d .)" && cmake --build /workspace/mercury-host/llama.cpp/build --config Release -j --target llama-server
